name: Blitzit
description_en:
Blitzit combines a personal task list with a focus-session panel, time estimates, Pomodoro breaks and recorded task time. Its Backlog, This Week and Today columns organize when a person intends to work, with the order in Today feeding the focus queue. Reports compare recorded time with estimates rather than independently measure work quality.

The current site also exposes a major version transition: Blitzit 3.0 is a beta rebuilt on a separate database while the general desktop download page still labels version 2.6.69. Existing users need the migration path, not simply an assumption that a mobile update will show all old tasks. No app, migration, timer or integration was run in this research.
description_zh:
Blitzit 把个人任务清单与专注面板、时间估算、番茄钟休息及任务工时记录结合。Backlog、This Week 和 Today 列表达个人打算何时工作，Today 中的排序进入专注队列。报告比较记录时间与估算，并不独立测量工作质量。

当前官网也呈现重大版本过渡：Blitzit 3.0 是使用独立数据库重建的 beta，通用桌面下载页仍标记 2.6.69。已有用户需要走迁移路径，不能假设更新手机应用就能看到全部旧任务。本次未运行应用、迁移、计时器或集成。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.

sections.title_en: Turn a small plan into an eligible focus queue
sections.title_zh: 把小计划整理成可启动的专注队列
sections.en:
For a hypothetical documentation revision, create a task, add the source link and acceptance notes, estimate forty minutes and put it near the top of Today. Keep later work in This Week or Backlog. Start Blitz Mode when ready; the guide says the top eligible Today item starts its timer. If every Today item is scheduled for a future time, the session will not start yet.

Treat checking off the task as a separate decision from reaching zero on the timer. A timer can make the intended work visible, but the final document still needs review. This is an evaluation example, not a completed session or evidence that Blitzit improves concentration, ADHD symptoms or delivery speed.
sections.zh:
假设修订一篇文档，可以创建任务、附上来源链接及验收说明、估算四十分钟，再排到 Today 靠前位置；较晚工作留在 This Week 或 Backlog。准备好后启动 Blitz Mode，指南称排在最前且符合时间条件的 Today 任务会启动计时。如果所有 Today 任务都安排在未来时间，专注会话暂不能启动。

勾选完成与计时归零应分别判断。计时器可提示当前工作，但最终文档仍需复核。这是评估样例，不是已完成会话，也不证明 Blitzit 改善注意力、ADHD 症状或交付速度。

sections.title_en: Choose the timer before interpreting the report
sections.title_zh: 解释报告前先确定计时模式
sections.en:
An estimate with Pomodoro off produces an EST countdown. Turning Pomodoro on gives its work/break cycle priority even when an estimate exists. With neither enabled, the timer counts upward. Elapsed task time is tracked in all three modes. Estimates and Time Taken can be edited while the live timer is paused.

For example, an estimated forty-minute task completed in fifty minutes is ten minutes over its estimate; that arithmetic does not establish whether its output is useful. The Time Spent guide defines punctuality as the proportion of task time completed early or late, not simply the proportion of tasks. Tasks without estimates lack the early/late indicator. Correct a known interruption before comparing periods, and do not treat editable records as an immutable billing audit.
sections.zh:
设置估算且关闭番茄钟时使用 EST 倒计时；启用番茄钟后，即使有估算，也优先采用工作／休息循环；两者都没有时向上计时。三种模式都记录任务经过时间。实时计时暂停后可编辑估算及 Time Taken。

例如，估算四十分钟的任务用了五十分钟，即超出十分钟；这不证明产出是否有用。Time Spent 指南把准时性定义为提前或超时任务所占的时间比例，不是简单的任务数量比例。无估算任务没有提前／超时指标。比较不同时期前应修正已知中断，也不能把可编辑记录当作不可变计费审计。

sections.title_en: One-way import can still delete a source event
sections.title_zh: 单向导入仍可能删除源事件
sections.en:
The Google Calendar guide imports selected events into one linked Blitzit list, with one Google account per list and a configured look-ahead range. Source title/time changes flow into Blitzit; creating events from Blitzit is described as future work. That does not mean every operation is read-only.

When Sync Delete is enabled, deleting the Blitzit task also deletes its linked Google event. Deleting the Google event instead unlinks it and retains the Blitzit task. Before connecting a real calendar, inspect that setting and test a disposable event with a known title/time in both systems. If events are missing, the guide recommends checking date range/calendars and refreshing the sync. No calendar or deletion was tested here.
sections.zh:
Google Calendar 指南把所选事件导入一个关联的 Blitzit 列表，每个列表只能关联一个 Google 账户，并有可配置的向前导入范围。源标题／时间变更进入 Blitzit；从 Blitzit 创建事件被列为未来功能。但这不代表所有操作只读。

启用 Sync Delete 后，删除 Blitzit 任务也会删除关联的 Google 事件；反过来删除 Google 事件只解除关联，保留 Blitzit 任务。连接真实日历前应检查此设置，用标题／时间已知的可丢弃事件检查两端。事件缺失时，指南建议核对日期范围、日历选择并刷新同步。本次未测试日历或删除。

sections.title_en: Review the task draft and the connection version
sections.title_zh: 复核任务草稿及连接版本
sections.en:
Blitzy can draft tasks with notes, subtasks, estimated time and schedule, then let the user refine and add the task. Its existing-task guide includes confirmation in an estimate-change example. It separately labels meeting-note capture, smarter prioritization and workflow analysis as upcoming; those should not be assumed available.

External assistant access uses a separate OAuth MCP connection. The setup guide lists different endpoints for older versions and 3.x and warns that the integration is early-stage. Check the app/database version, target list and saved result before expanding it beyond a minimal task. The vendor’s external assistant UI and subscription instructions may change; they were not independently verified. No agent, OAuth grant or task write was executed, and no universal confirmation/undo guarantee is inferred.
sections.zh:
Blitzy 可拟定带备注、子任务、估算及日程的任务，供用户继续修改后添加。已有任务指南在修改估算的样例中包含确认；它另把会议记录、更智能排序和流程分析标为即将推出，不能假设已经可用。

外部助手访问采用独立 OAuth MCP 连接，指南区分旧版及 3.x 端点，并提示集成尚处早期。扩大到最小任务以外前，应核对应用／数据库版本、目标列表及保存结果。厂商所述外部助手界面和订阅步骤可能变化，本次未独立验证。没有连接代理、授予 OAuth 或写入任务，也不推断所有操作都有统一确认／撤销保证。

sections.title_en: Migrate a copy before relying on the new mobile app
sections.title_zh: 依赖新手机应用前先迁移副本
sections.en:
The 3.0 guide recommends desktop-first setup using the email associated with the old account. Selected lists/tasks are copied into the new database; changes in 3.0 do not sync back to 2.x. It acknowledges that some archived-list migrations can omit tasks and advises retaining original data and contacting support. Existing paid/Lifetime purchases remain valid; a missing plan is not an instruction to buy again.

After migration, compare one active list, an archived list and a recurring rule. Future occurrences are managed by 3.0, so keeping both versions actively generating the same recurring work can create inconsistent copies. The guide recommends managing migrated schedules in 3.0 only while retaining old data for checks. This research verified the instructions, not their successful execution or current beta stability.
sections.zh:
3.0 指南建议先在桌面端使用旧账户关联邮箱设置。选中的列表／任务复制到新数据库，3.0 的变更不会同步回 2.x。指南承认某些归档列表迁移可能缺任务，建议保留原数据并联系支持。已有付费／Lifetime 购买仍有效，方案未显示不意味着需要重买。

迁移后应比较一个活跃列表、一个归档列表及一条重复规则。后续实例由 3.0 管理，两版同时生成相同重复工作可能形成不一致副本。指南建议只在 3.0 管理已迁移日程，同时保留旧数据用于检查。本次核实的是说明，不是迁移执行成功或 beta 稳定性。

sections.title_en: Check checkout against conflicting public promises
sections.title_zh: 用结账条件核对公开承诺差异
sections.en:
The homepage displays $6.99 monthly and $59.88 annually, expressed as $4.99/month, alongside a New Year coupon and a thirty-day money-back promise. Treat the promotion as a displayed offer to recheck, not a guaranteed October entitlement. The terms describe a seven-day trial that converts to the current monthly rate unless canceled, and say cancellation does not refund earlier payments. Those statements leave the trial/payment/refund conditions unresolved.

Inspect the in-app plan, renewal date, currency, AI allowance and actual checkout terms before paying. Billing management opens Stripe; old activation/Lifetime instructions do not establish that a new Lifetime offer is currently sold. A trial and a separate free browser Pomodoro tool do not establish sustained free access to the full task app. No purchase or refund was attempted.
sections.zh:
首页显示月付 $6.99、年付 $59.88（折合每月 $4.99），并列有新年优惠码及三十天退款承诺。应把促销当作需要重查的展示报价，不能保证十月仍适用。条款称七天试用若不取消会转为当时月费，并称取消不退已付款项。这些说明使试用／付款／退款条件仍未统一。

付款前应检查应用内方案、续期日、币种、AI 额度及实际结账条款。账单管理打开 Stripe；旧激活码／Lifetime 指南不证明当前仍销售新的终身方案。试用及独立免费网页番茄钟也不能确立完整任务应用持续免费。本次未购买或申请退款。

sections.title_en: Keep completed history separate from deletion
sections.en:
The deletion guide says permanently deleted tasks cannot be recovered and disappear from reports. Lists are archived before permanent deletion, which also removes their tasks; archiving itself can be reversed. Done tasks older than sixty days move into an archived area automatically. The homepage still marks PDF report export as coming soon, so a verified full backup/restore format was not established.

Blitzit is a plausible shortlist for someone who wants an ordered personal task queue and a visible focus timer. Teams needing approval controls, invoicing or authoritative records should evaluate those separately. The terms reserve the vendor’s software rights and restrict copying/modification; desktop installation is not an open-source or self-hosted backend license. No export, restore or regulatory suitability test was performed.
sections.zh:
删除指南称永久删除的任务无法恢复，也会从报告消失。列表需先归档再永久删除，后者同时删除其中任务；归档本身可撤销。完成超过六十天的任务会自动进入归档区。首页仍把 PDF 报告导出标为即将推出，本次未确立可验证的完整备份／恢复格式。

需要有序个人任务队列和可见专注计时器时，Blitzit 可列入候选。团队审批、开票或权威记录需求应另行评估。条款保留厂商软件权利并限制复制／修改，安装桌面端不等于获得开源或自托管后端许可。本次未执行导出、恢复或监管适用性测试。
